scope: Current-input Morton groups in private VTM seed queries. Exact group min/max boxes, existing conservative sphere-box and point/symbolic tests. Adds 24 bytes per group and one preparation launch per invocation; no temporal proof or CPU outperformance claim. The existing routed full allocation-order instrumentation limitation remains.
